items.description: GET / serves an HTML page with a numeric input, source and destination unit selectors, submit button, result and visible error feedback.
POST /api/convert accepts JSON {"value":number,"from":"C"|"F"|"K","to":"C"|"F"|"K"} and returns 200 {"value":number,"unit":destination unit} without integer rounding.
Use C=(F-32)*5/9 and K=C+273.15; same-unit preserves value; negative C/F valid above absolute zero.

Reject missing fields, nonnumeric/boolean values, unsupported units, malformed JSON, below-absolute-zero (even same-unit) with HTTP 400 {"error": nonempty string}; allow insignificant float error at boundaries -273.15 C / -459.67 F / 0 K.
Conversion logic separated from HTTP handling and testable without a running server; npm test meaningful; npm run build checks source syntax.
npm start uses process.env.PORT (default 3000); no external runtime services; README documents install/start/test and limitations.
Component flow User -> Browser page -> HTTP -> Convert and back, returning JSON/HTTP 200 or 400 to the UI.
